thesis_summary.thesis: AST SpaceMobile is building a constellation of large low-Earth-orbit satellites that connect directly to unmodified smartphones through partner mobile network operators. **[Fact]** The company designs BlueBird (BB) satellites with phased arrays up to roughly 2,400 square feet and sells service through revenue-sharing agreements with carriers such as Vodafone, Rakuten, AT&T, and Bell Canada rather than selling phones or retail plans itself. **[Fact]** FY2025 total revenue was **$70.9 million** (+1,505% versus **$4.4 million** in FY2024), while net loss attributable to common stockholders was **$341.9 million**. **[Fact]** At March 31, 2026 the company held **$3.03 billion** in cash and **$2.96 billion** of long-term debt, primarily convertible notes. **[Fact]** Q1 2026 revenue was **$14.7 million** versus **$0.7 million** in Q1 2025.
thesis_summary.why_market_wrong: **Predictive attribute:** complexity discount (pre-profit satellite platform with convertible debt stack, equity raises, and binary commercial ramp).

key_assumptions.source: FY2025 OCF minus capex per 10-K FY2025
